description: Conformance cases of the rule AST (MET-45, api/rules.schema.json). backend/internal/rules/rules_test.go and frontend/src/rules/rules.test.ts both run every case. cases: rule must be a valid value rule and evaluate to exactly the listed violation codes; invalid_rules must be rejected. absent: true means the field has no value at all. condition_cases (WP-715): condition must be a valid condition and evaluate to result for the record values (a field missing from values is absent); the cases named reference: and reference list: compare reference attributes (WP-254: user, location, reference and the other alias types hold the id of the target as text, multi_value a list of ids, finding F-2 of WP-326); backend/internal/fieldmeta/fieldmeta_test.go also evaluates the cases of comparisons and all of comparisons through fieldmeta.Evaluate. invalid_conditions must be rejected, the error message starting with path and a colon. expressions (WP-258): expr must be a valid expression ($defs/expr) and evaluate to result (null: empty) for inputs (attributes by key, asset fields as asset.<field>; a key missing from inputs is absent), now (RFC 3339) and timezone (IANA); invalid_expressions must be rejected, the error message starting with path and a colon. backend/internal/rules/rules_test.go (rules.ParseExpr, rules.EvalExpr) and, as the second evaluation, frontend/src/rules/rules.test.ts (parseExpr, evalExpr in frontend/src/rules/expr.ts, WP-802) run every expression case. filter_cases (WP-789): filter must be a valid filter AST ($defs/filter) for entity_kind; invalid_filters must be rejected naming path (where.<path>) before a colon. backend/internal/savedview/filter_test.go runs both through Expr.Validate, frontend/src/rules/filter.test.ts through parseFilter; the cases check structure, operators, value forms, limits and related, while the field whitelist, attribute definitions, tags and relationship types stay in the Go tests.
